mapper.sql: select calibration_id, instrument_id, calibration_code, calibration_type, calibration_org, calibration_date, next_calibration, calibration_result, certificate_no, certificate_file, calibrated_by, approved_by, status from lims_instrument_calibration
mapper.select: where instrument_id = #{instrumentId} order by calibration_date desc
mapper.delete: delete from lims_instrument_calibration where calibration_id in #{id}
